items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I don’t know Al Porcino that well. ... we know each other professionally

ctx.x: Wow. Fascinating. Sad. Let me wrap up here by asking if September 11th changed your life much, either from a music standpoint or in any other regards.

That’s a hard one. I mean I really don’t think so. Maybe I should see my analyst to be sure. I’m only kidding. I mean it was a terrible thing, an awful thing, as a matter of fact I’ll never forget the first phone call, well the first phone call that I got that morning, and I © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-

had seen it on television, as a matter of fact it may have been happening, no it had just happened when I talked to this person, Al Porcino called me from Munich, Germany. Do you know the name Al Porcino?
